content: परिक्षेपः .²1 Moving about, walking to and fro. .²2 Scattering, spreading. .²3 Surrounding, encircling, circumfluence; circuit; अहोरात्रपरिक्षेपम् <ls>Mb. 14. 45. 3</ls>. .²2 An enclosing belt or boundary, that by which anything is surrounded; महार्णवपरिक्षेपं लङ्कायाः परिखालघुम् (मेने) <ls>R. 12. 66</ls>. .²5 Abandoning, leaving. .²6 An organ of sense.
